reason: Classified as a navigation panel plugin because it centers on terminal UI session navigation and monitoring (`/subagents` list plus full-screen trajectory view), with in-place controls for continuation and interruption of child agents. The evidence shows direct user-facing interaction rather than code generation, data processing, or external service integration.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 dsh-TUI 插件，通过 `/subagents` 列出当前会话中的子 Agent，并提供全屏轨迹视图实时查看其思考、工具调用与回复，支持对可续子 Agent 发送 follow-up 或中断当前轮次。
summaries.en: This dsh-TUI plugin lets users list current-session subagents with `/subagents`, open a full-screen trajectory view with live updates, and send follow-up input or interrupt a continuation-capable subagent turn.

capabilities: List subagents for the current session
Open a full-screen trajectory view for a selected subagent
Render live session event streams (reasoning, tool calls, replies)
Send follow-up messages to continuable subagents
Backfill history from live or persisted session data
Fallback to plain text list mode when scene support is unavailable

reasons.code: Repository description and README define the plugin as a read-only live subagent viewer with `/subagents` and full-screen trajectory viewing.
README documents interactive controls in the trajectory view, including `i` for follow-up messaging and `x` for turn interruption on continuable subagents.
README states updates are driven by `session/event` and uses `ctx.subagents.followup`/`ctx.subagents.interrupt`, indicating runtime interaction with subagent sessions.
package.json declares this as a dsh plugin bundle with declared main entry and dsh patch wiring.
